dedupe_keys.name: crtc communications market reports open data telecom internet mobile and broadcasting sectors canada

description: The CRTC publishes the data behind its Communications Market Reports (CMR), formerly the Communications Monitoring Reports, as a series of open datasets on the Government of Canada portal; 30 CMR-related datasets were listed when searched. Current series cover the telecommunications sector (revenues for local and access, long distance, data, private line, fixed internet and mobile services, capital expenditure, EBITDA, complaints and wholesale), the retail fixed internet sector from 2013 to 2022 (subscriptions and revenues for incumbent, cable and other providers, with broadband availability collected with ISED), the retail mobile sector, the television, radio, broadcasting and broadcasting distribution sectors from 2013 to 2024, quarterly current trends from 2014 to 2025, year-end prices for internet and mobile services, household subscriptions and spending, and older annual reports back to 2008 for broadcasting. Coverage: Canada, by province, provider type and urban or rural area for some series. Format and access: CSV and XLSX files with PDF or DOCX data dictionaries in English and French, free under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Caveats: aggregated by provider groups; series definitions changed over time and some sector series stop in 2022. Simulation uses: sizing telecom and broadcast demand and investment by province, and economic context for outage impact studies. Related records: ISED National Broadband Data give availability maps, and the Statistics Canada internet use survey gives household use.
